mining.mapping: Choose Add, deck Sentences and model Sentence Card. Map sentence → Sentence, definition → Definition, word → Word, source → Source, URL → URL.

form.title: Create Flama Connect API Token
form.description: Each device or browser should use a dedicated token for easy monitoring and secure revocation. See <link>Detailed Connection Guide</link> if this is your first time.
form.name_placeholder: e.g. Yomitan - Chrome PC / Kiwi Mobile
form.config_alert_text: Generate a token and paste the full issued URL into the <bold>Server URL</bold> field in Yomitan Settings (Settings ➔ Anki/Connect) without entering a separate API Key.
form.config_alert_ref: Refer to the <link1>Setup Guide</link1> or <link2>55 Field Markers Table</link2> to map card template fields.
